text: The research is disseminated through three publications. The first presents the trust-oriented consent framework and its prototype, the second reports the systematic literature review of Section 2, and the third reports the formal assurance and the complete evaluation of the framework. {Tpub} summarises these publications, their target venues and their status at the time of writing.

text: It should be noted that the second and third publications build directly on the material of this report. The second publication extends Section 2 into a stand-alone review, and the third publication completes the work that Sections 10 and 11 identify as remaining for CA3.

The research plan is divided into the work completed at the CA2 milestone and the work planned for the remainder of the candidature. {Tplan} presents the previous and the coming tasks in chronological order, together with their target dates and their status.

text: As shown in {Fplan}, the chapters on the research foundation, the architecture and the proposed solution are complete, and the first publication has been submitted. The coming stage concentrates on RQ5 and RQ6. Consent modification, delegation and guardian-set changes extend the lifecycle trust of Section 10. The formal security assurance and the full performance, scalability and adversarial evaluation complete the work of Section 11.
